title: Microsoft Edge: simplified energy saver with new defaults and one mode
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned simplified energy saver from the existing documented policies. The roadmap facts, current controls and defaults are supported, and targeted searches found no documentation resolving the stated gaps.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to simplify Microsoft Edge energy saver, formerly efficiency mode.
claims.quote: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options.

claims.claim: The planned feature has two activation conditions: low battery or unplugged.
claims.quote: The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The planned default enables energy saver on low battery.
claims.quote: The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery.

claims.claim: The simplified energy saver will have one mode.
claims.quote: Energy saver will now have one mode.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to energy saver enabled on low battery.
claims.quote: Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled on low battery.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users set to Maximum savings will be mapped to energy saver enabled when unplugged.
claims.quote: Users set to Maximum savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled when unplugged.

claims.claim: Edge will support BatterySaverModeAvailability to manage energy saver.
claims.quote: Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature.

claims.claim: EfficiencyMode configures current energy-saver activation but has no effect when EfficiencyModeEnabled is disabled.
claims.quote: This policy setting lets you configure when energy saver becomes active. This policy has no effect if the EfficiencyModeEnabled policy is disabled.

claims.claim: EfficiencyModeEnabled governs existing efficiency-mode availability, and disabling it means efficiency mode is never active.
claims.quote: Enables efficiency mode which helps extend battery life by saving computer resources. If you disable this policy, efficiency mode is never active.
